subject: Zion Tech Group — mutually beneficial AI/IT partnership proposal
body:
Hi,

I’m following up with a concrete partnership angle rather than a generic intro.

We can create shared value through:

  • Co-selling Zion’s AI/IT managed services with margin-sharing or referral structure
  • A joint pilot in support automation, observability, or field service readiness with measurable success criteria
  • Cross-promotion of each other’s free tools and assessments to warm audiences

We have new AI services and free tools at https://ziontechgroup.com that can strengthen both our pipelines without heavy upfront investment.

If useful, let’s align on a short call: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup

Best,
Kleber Garcia Alcatrao
CEO — Zion Tech Group
llm_instruction: Rewrite in the recipient’s language and conversational tone; preserve concrete partnership options, mutual benefit, and the Calendly/ziontechgroup.com CTAs.
